explanation: This unit is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and is active only at the GO step when the agent chooses a1: it hits about 9-10 when the previous trial went unrewarded, starts near 3-4 after one rewarded trial and falls by about 1 for each further reward in a row to 0, and is weaker after several unrewarded trials in a row (about 3-7) and early in the episode (trials before about 60 often sit at 0-3). A2 choices are almost always 0, with only an occasional 1-6 when the previous trial went unrewarded.
